name: Nager.Date Public Holidays API
summary: Public holidays for 100+ countries, with long-weekend calculation.
description: Free keyless API returning public holidays by year and country (names in English and local language, global/regional flag, types), next holidays, today-is-holiday checks and long weekends.

example.response_excerpt:
[
 {
  "date": "2026-01-01",
  "localName": "Neujahr",
  "name": "New Year's Day",
  "countryCode": "DE",
  "fixed": false,
  "global": true,
  "counties": null,
  "launchYear": null,
  "types": [
   "Public"
  ]
 },
...

agent_notes: Use ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes. Regional holidays carry county codes and global=false. IsTodayPublicHoliday signals via status code (200 holiday, 204 not).
caveats: Documentation moved to nagerholidays.com; regional holidays are given via counties codes.

verification.notes: Re-checked 2026-11-11 with curl on /PublicHolidays/2026/DE: HTTP 200 with access-control-allow-origin: *.
